style: Say slowly and very clearly, like a warm teacher modeling English phrases for young newcomers
lines: May I go to the bathroom?
You really need to use the bathroom during class.
May I get a drink of water?
After recess you are very thirsty.
I don't feel well.
Your tummy hurts and you feel hot.
May I have a tissue, please?
Achoo! Your nose is runny.
I need help, please.
You are stuck on your work and can't do the next part.
Can you say that again, please?
The teacher talked fast and you didn't hear the directions.
I don't understand.
You heard the directions, but they don't make sense to you.
How do you say this in English?
You know a word in your language, but not in English.
May I have a pencil, please?
Snap! Your pencil broke.
Where do I put this?
You finished your art project and don't know where it goes.
I'm finished!
You wrote your last word and colored the picture.
I lost my mitten.
It's time to go home, but one mitten is missing.
Can I play too?
Some kids are playing ball, and you want to join.
Thank you!
A friend shares crayons with you.
Excuse me.
You need to walk past someone in a narrow space.
Good morning!
You walk into the classroom and see your teacher.
What do you say?
Yes!
Try again!
Tap a phrase to learn it.
